course_name_original: Energieeffiziente Heiz- und Kühlsysteme im Anlagenbau
course_name_en: Energy-efficient Heating and Cooling Systems in Plant Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Application of scientific principles using the example of plant systems for heating, cooling, and air conditioning.

Reliably identify, describe, evaluate, and solve fluid- and thermodynamic as well as mechanical engineering problems occurring in energy technology plants, and derive well-founded own judgments from them.
Independently recognize interface problems and the interaction of disciplines.
Students are able to explain technical facts in oral or written presentations.

syllabus_topics: Heating system / Hot water system: Structure of a heating system with heat generator, buffer storage, circulation pump, radiators..
Heat demand calculation according to building standards for the design of heating system / hot water
Climate and ventilation system: Design of ventilation for buildings (Example: school building)
Standards for calculating the necessary fresh air volume for individual rooms
Function and structure of an air handling unit (RLT-Anlage)
Cold storage / Air conditioning: Dimensioning of a refrigeration system for a cold storage room
Compound systems with multiple cooling points
Networked systems: Heat recovery (Example: waste heat from refrigeration system for hot water generation)
PCM heat storage (Example: swimming pool heating with mobile heat from biogas plant)
Systems with storage of heat/energy (e.g. ice storage, geothermal probes, ..)
Hydraulic design of piping systems with fittings (hydraulic balancing, k-value, etc…)
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
